title: Family Handoff Calendar
user: Two-parent households juggling school, work, pickups, and activities who need to see who is responsible at each handoff without committing their family schedule to Google or Apple.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA importing/exporting ICS, with named household members, handoff/pickup tags, a next-48-hours responsibility board, and a printable week sheet.
success_measure: In a four-week pilot, households record 80% of scheduled handoffs and report zero missed handoffs caused by unclear ownership.
constraints: Calendar data remains local; careful timezone/ICS handling; do not collect children's data or offer tracking; shared-device export must be explicit.
